## [R-452 conditional history-resolvent recurrence envelope] - 2026-08-31

Added R-452 as a claim-nonbearing T-054 analytic interface. The exact one-step history recurrence has a finite resolvent with separate nonresonant and resonant branches; the inherited parent decay gives the sufficient owner threshold kappa<1. Primary, independent, hostile, integrated and Lean checks pass. The source-owned recurrence, coefficient, common domain, exhaustion, common-alpha, physical and continuum obligations remain open, and the existing forward and observation-first inverse methods are unchanged.

## [R-453 defect-stable history-resolvent] - 2026-08-31

Added R-453 as an additive T-054 analytic interface downstream of R-452. A nonnegative residual in the unchanged one-step history recurrence contributes the exact step-indexed convolution sum kappa^(R-j) delta_j; a geometric residual bound gives the second resolvent D*S_R(kappa,s), with separate resonant branches and sufficient threshold kappa<1 and s<1. Primary 29752/29752, independent 14827/14827, hostile 14/14, integrated 19/19 and Lean R453 pass. The source-owned recurrence, residual, common domain, exhaustion, common-alpha, physical and continuum obligations remain open. Existing T-054, T-059 and T-061 methods and owner order are unchanged; no tier change, negative result or PDF.

## [R-454 variable-coefficient defect-stable history-resolvent] - 2026-08-31

R-454 is an additive T-054 refinement downstream of R-453. It proves, by exact path-product domination, that the unchanged source-plus-defect history-resolvent envelope remains valid when each nonnegative propagation coefficient kappa_R varies by step but is bounded by one common kappa_bar. The geometric residual specialization, unequal-base and resonant branches are checked by primary, non-importing independent, hostile, integrated and Lean lanes. This is a T0 conditional scalar admission contract: the source-owned Q3 recurrence, coefficient bound, residual, common domain, uniformity, exhaustion, physical identity, continuum and Clay obligations remain open. Existing T-054/T-059/T-061 methods and owner order are unchanged.

## [R-455 nonnegative transfer-matrix defect-resolvent envelope] - 2026-08-31

Added R-455 as an additive T-054 owner-intake interface. An entrywise nonnegative coupled vector recurrence with one common induced infinity-row-sum bound has the unchanged R-454 source-plus-defect envelope, including exact path order, nonresonant and resonant branches, and the kappa_bar<1, s<1 threshold. Primary 373915/373915, independent 250290/250290, hostile 20/20 and integrated plus Lean pass. This remains T0 and claim-nonbearing: no source-owned Q3 law, common domain, uniformity, exhaustion, physical sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result follows. Existing T-054/T-059/T-061 methods and owner order are unchanged.

## [R-456 conditional weighted transfer-operator defect-resolvent envelope] - 2026-08-31

R-456 / EXP-001329 adds an additive finite positive weighted transfer-operator contract above R-455. For strictly positive coordinate weights, nonnegative transfer matrices with one common weighted row-sum bound are diagonally conjugate to the existing infinity-row-sum contract, so the same path-product and source-plus-defect envelope holds with weighted norms. Primary 290560/290560, independent 231840, hostile 22/22, integrated 22/22 and Lean pass over 17 radius rows, 46 bound/defect pairs, dimensions 1-3, five weight patterns, seven transfer patterns and 77280 terminal paths. Source-owned weights/transfer/history, common weighted domain, uniformity, physical sector, continuum, Yang-Mills and mass-gap gates remain open; T-054/T-059/T-061 methods and owner order are unchanged.

## [R-457 finite M3 compact-U(1) equation-level audit] - 2026-08-31

R-457 adds an exact finite equation-level audit to the existing M3 compact-U(1) design. Primary and independent site-charge checks cover L=2,3 plaquettes, covariant norms, observables and Gauss factors; the conditional Gauss-neutrality, Poisson self-bracket and completion-square identities pass, while hostile mutations and Lean R457 are rejected/pass as specified. The source owner and candidate remain unadmitted; no physical, continuum, QFT, Yang-Mills, Pre-A or mass-gap conclusion follows, and T-054/T-059/T-061 methods and owner order are unchanged.
